newsitem.title: USA: Delphi Financial files to list stock.
newsitem.headline: Delphi Financial files to list stock.

text.p: Delphi Financial Group Inc said it had filed an application to list its Class A Common Stock on the New York Stock Exchange.
The company said it expected trading to begin on the exchange by October 31 under the symbol "DFG."
"We believe this move will enhance the liquidity of Delphi's Class A shares, reduce transaction costs for our shareholders and stimulate additional investor and analyst interest in Delphi," it said.
Delphi Financial Group Inc is the parent company of Reliance Standard Life Insurance Co and Safety National Casualty Corp, providing group employee benefits.
